scope: Concrete successes, observed limitations and refusal/validation checks. Do not sum these into an accuracy score.

limitations.desired: Resolve She to Alice when the discourse establishes that reference, or explicitly request disambiguation.
limitations.reason: No discourse or entity resolver is called. She is an ordinary identifier and the state has no fact at(She,...).

limitations.desired: Accept the sentence without the final period.
limitations.reason: The hand-written whole-sentence pattern includes the final period as a token.

limitations.desired: Find a program satisfying both supplied example sets.
limitations.reason: Intermediate programs are deduplicated using training outputs only. On the all-zero training set their outputs collide; the necessary sum intermediate is dropped. unknown is not a completeness result, even for a representable program.
The demonstrations never distinguish asker and respondent. Abstraction groups their identical value columns into one slot. Distinguishing roles requires discriminating demonstrations.

limitations.desired: Reject two simultaneous locations for a person under the benchmark world contract.
limitations.reason: The core operates on tuples and does not enforce the test-world invariants on arbitrary caller input.

limitations.desired: Replay the same result after unrelated dependency changes.
limitations.reason: Only the parent source is addressed by hash. Transitive dependencies and the runtime are not pinned by this activation store.
